$comment: Committed size baseline for the Worker a `templates/standalone` app deploys, measured by scripts/check-worker-size.js against a production build. Cloudflare's Worker size limit is 64 MiB uncompressed on both plans, and there is no compressed limit; the script checks that ceiling separately against rawBytes. The gzipBytes baseline is only a framework-weight regression signal, not a proximity alarm. `pnpm run worker-size:update` re-baselines an intentional increase.
